name: Terranus the End of Worlds
description:
God Emperor Terranus the Savior of Humanity and now the End.
 After hundreds of thousands of years, his mission is now near complete, and only one last action remains. For a new beginning, there must first be an end.

This is an Expansion Item for Forever Supper, the biggest cryptoart collaboration. Claim your free Core and customise it with the Expansions you collect here: https://async.market/dynamic-blueprints/63fe742c74e62000a8cf7bb8/async-forever-supper
